_doc: Log-specific input for loan_model/mine_stage_model.py (schema: loan_model/STAGE_MODEL_SCHEMA.md). BPI Challenge 2019 (purchase-to-pay), item category '3-way match, invoice before GR' only; a case is a purchase-order item. The log has completion events only: loan_model/prepare_bpic2019.py estimates the start of every staff work step (start-time repair with calendar and simultaneous batches, loan_model/start_times.py) and writes the event table this map points to. As in Consulta, a stage is entered when its work item starts, and the wait until the next work item starts is the tail of the stage before it. Arrival = creation of the purchase-order item (the requisition, 19% of items, is a date-only system record and is ignored). Batch users and events without a user are 'automated' (no worker). Clear Invoice is the payment (weekly payment run, modelled in Phase 3); Delete Purchase Order Item ends a case without payment.

estimation_calendar._doc: start of the working day for the start-time estimate: 1% quantile of the hour of human completion events (6:00-18:00 local)

ignored_activities: SRM: In Transfer to Execution Syst.

batch_release._doc: weekly payment run: 98.8% of payments are booked at moments when >=10 items are paid together; a run is a day with >=200 payments: 51 run days with 96% of payments (42 Thursdays, 7 Fridays), 90% by user_002. Mined: the run schedule (weeks with a run, runs per week, weekday, time of day) and per transition to END_paid the due lag (end of the last work -> payable, interval-censored between the previous run and the paying run) and the share of payments made by a run.

_simulation_scale: the simulator generates 10% of the mined arrival rate (user, 2026-11-19); the top-3 pool is unchanged
